title: Cross-site request forgery against cookie-authenticated TypeScript endpoints
preconditions: browser-originated state change uses ambient cookies
cross-origin form/fetch reaches a mutation route
dangerous_transitions: ambient cookie authorization accepts a cross-site state-changing request without a valid CSRF defense
sink_semantics: cookie-authenticated JSON/form endpoints and credentialed fetch handlers
counterevidence: A verified anti-CSRF token/origin policy protects every state-changing cookie-authenticated route.
verification_recipe: Map cookie attributes and route methods, then test cross-site form and credentialed fetch controls.
Check origin/referrer validation and token binding on aliases.
